answer.rationale: Write-path p99 is 5x with two concurrent explanations: a release 2h ago (symptoms started ~30m later) and settlement-peak write load. memory_b1 is the closest successful write-availability restore and is the one record worth re-checking (it describes an error spike, not latency). Circuit breaking would fail customer writes and violates the objective; replica routing (b5) was for report/dashboard reads, not settlement writes; failover (b2) has no regional signal. Peak headroom (b3) remains a live alternative cause, so this is a standard reversible rollback rather than a fleet-wide leap, and settlement-value risk is flagged. Cause is not known.
